experiment: IXI literature-scale RelationFormer B0 control (D08 recipe, synthetic init)

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: Linear 1%-100% warmup over 5 epochs, then cosine to 1e-6 over the entire 100 epochs (31,200 updates); never reset at job boundaries

augmentation: Existing quarter-turn rotations in DH/DW/HW plus Gaussian noise p=.35, std uniformly 0-.015, no zoom. Per-(epoch,sample) seeds are independent of arm/workers/resume.

thresholds.selection: train_monitor (256 training patches) only: node threshold maximizing node F1 at 2 mm, then edge threshold maximizing edge F1 at 2 mm given that node threshold; ties -> higher threshold. Applied unchanged to validation.

metrics: Physical node/edge P/R/F1 at 2 mm (and 1 mm) via diagnose_branch_relations.match_nodes + ixi_query_diagnostics.edge_accounting; common-v2 Branch/Curve F1 via metrics/common_vessel_metrics; node AP (physical 2 mm, all 256 proposals), edge ranking AP (D08 all-retained/conditional), RelationFormer box mAP (training/evaluation/metrics).
checkpoint_policy: Immutable model checkpoints at 25/50/75/100; resumable latest (model+optimizer+RNG) after every epoch
precision: float32; no AMP or gradient accumulation
limitations: One training seed. Annotation-relative graph errors. No test images/targets accessed.
